faqItems.q: What is a Sinhala voice transcriber?
faqItems.a: A Sinhala voice transcriber turns spoken Sinhala into written Sinhala text. HelaVoice is one: record in your browser or upload an audio file, and you get an editable Sinhala transcript to copy or download.

faqItems.q: How do I convert Sinhala voice to text?
faqItems.a: Sign in to HelaVoice, then record in your browser or upload an audio file. HelaVoice transcribes it in {chunkMin}-minute parts and shows the Sinhala text, which you can edit, copy, or download as PDF, Word, TXT or Markdown. It works for voice notes, meetings, lectures and interviews.

faqItems.q: How do I transcribe Sinhala audio to text?
faqItems.a: Sign up for a free HelaVoice account, then either record audio directly in your browser or upload an existing audio file (MP3, WAV, WebM, OGG, FLAC, or M4A). HelaVoice transcribes it and returns the Sinhala transcript, which you can copy, edit, or download.

faqItems.q: Is there an online Sinhala audio to text converter?
faqItems.a: Yes. HelaVoice is an online Sinhala audio to text converter. Upload an audio file (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC or WebM) or record in your browser, and you get an editable Sinhala transcript. There is nothing to install, and 1 credit covers up to {chunkMin} minutes of audio.

faqItems.q: What is the difference between Sinhala voice typing and transcription?
faqItems.a: Voice typing writes your words live while you speak into the microphone, and it is free on our Sinhala voice typing page. Transcription turns a recording you already have, such as a voice note, meeting or interview, into text, and uses 1 credit per {chunkMin} minutes of audio.

faqItems.q: Can HelaVoice turn Sinhala text into speech?
faqItems.a: Yes, with a separate tool. Our Sinhala text to speech tool reads typed Sinhala aloud in a choice of eight voices, and you can download the audio as a WAV file.

faqItems.q: How accurate is HelaVoice for Sinhala speech-to-text?
faqItems.a: Accuracy depends mostly on the recording. Clear audio with one speaker and little background noise gives the best transcript. Music, people talking over each other and phone-call audio cause more mistakes. Every transcript opens in an editor, so you can fix words before you export. Test a short clip first: 1 credit covers {chunkMin} minutes.

faqItems.q: What does "transcribe" mean in Sinhala?
faqItems.a: In Sinhala, "transcribe" is usually translated as "පරිවර්තනය කිරීම" or "ලිවීම": writing spoken words down as text. HelaVoice does this for Sinhala audio.

faqItems.q: Can I transcribe Sinhala audio messages (WhatsApp or voice notes)?
faqItems.a: Yes. Save the voice note from WhatsApp or your messaging app to your phone or computer, then upload it to HelaVoice. Voice-note formats such as M4A, OGG and MP3 work, up to {maxMb} MB per file.

faqItems.q: How much does HelaVoice cost?
faqItems.a: HelaVoice charges by length: 1 credit covers up to {chunkMin} minutes of audio, and credits never expire. Credit packs start at {starterPrice} for {starterCredits} credits, with no subscription.

faqItems.q: What audio formats and file sizes are supported?
faqItems.a: HelaVoice accepts MP3, WAV, WebM, OGG, FLAC and M4A files up to {maxMb} MB each. You can also record in your browser without installing anything.

faqItems.q: How do I generate Sinhala subtitles for a video?
faqItems.a: Sign in to HelaVoice, open Video Subtitles, and upload your video (MP4, WebM, or MOV). The AI transcribes the audio into timed Sinhala subtitle segments in minutes. You can then edit the text, adjust timings on a timeline, style the subtitles, and export an SRT/VTT file or an MP4 with the subtitles burned in.

faqItems.q: How do I add Sinhala captions to a TikTok, Reel or YouTube video?
faqItems.a: Upload the video to our Sinhala subtitle generator, let the AI write timed Sinhala captions, and fix any words. Then export an MP4 with the captions burned in for TikTok, Instagram Reels or Facebook, or an SRT file to upload to YouTube.

faqItems.q: Is a subtitle generator the same as a caption generator?
faqItems.a: For most creators, yes: both put the spoken words on screen as timed text. HelaVoice writes that text once and you choose how to use it: an SRT or VTT file that viewers can switch on and off, or captions burned into the video so they always show.

faqItems.q: Is my video uploaded to your servers?
faqItems.a: No. Your video never leaves your device — HelaVoice extracts the audio track in your browser and only sends short audio chunks for transcription. Subtitle export and video rendering also happen entirely on your device.

faqItems.q: What subtitle formats can I export?
faqItems.a: You can export standard SRT and WebVTT subtitle files, which work with YouTube, VLC, CapCut, Premiere Pro, and most video editors. You can also export an MP4 copy of your video with the styled subtitles burned in — for free.

faqItems.q: How much does it cost?
faqItems.a: Subtitle generation costs 2 credits per minute of video, using the same credit balance as transcription. Editing, styling, translation previews, and all exports are free. New accounts get free credits on signup.

faqItems.q: Can I translate Sinhala subtitles to English?
faqItems.a: Yes. After generating subtitles, one click translates the whole subtitle track between Sinhala and English while keeping all the timings — billed at the standard translation rate of 1 credit per 1,000 characters.

faqItems.q: Is this QR code generator really free?
faqItems.a: Yes. You can create and download unlimited QR codes for free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no expiry date.

faqItems.q: Can I add a logo to the QR code?
faqItems.a: Yes. Upload any PNG, JPG or SVG logo and it is placed in the centre of the QR code. We automatically raise the error-correction level so the code still scans reliably with the logo in place.

faqItems.q: Do the QR codes expire?
faqItems.a: No. These are static QR codes — the information is encoded directly into the pattern, so they keep working forever. There is no subscription and nothing to renew.

faqItems.q: Which format should I download?
faqItems.a: Use PNG or JPG for websites, social media and everyday printing. Use SVG when you need to print large — on banners, posters or packaging — because it stays perfectly sharp at any size.

faqItems.q: Can I make a WiFi QR code?
faqItems.a: Yes. Choose the WiFi tab, enter your network name and password, and anyone who scans the code will connect automatically — no need to type the password.

faqItems.q: Is my data safe?
faqItems.a: Yes. Every QR code is generated inside your browser. Your URLs, WiFi passwords, contact details and logos are never sent to or stored on any server.

faqItems.q: How do I type Sinhala using English letters?
faqItems.a: Type each word the way it sounds in English letters, for example “mama gedhara yanavaa”. The tool turns it into Sinhala Unicode (මම ගෙදර යනවා) as you type. Use th for ත, dh for ද, t for ට and d for ඩ, and double a vowel to make it long (aa = ා).

faqItems.q: Is this Sinhala keyboard free?
faqItems.a: Yes. The Singlish typing tool is completely free with no sign-up and no limits. It runs in your browser, so there is nothing to install.

faqItems.q: Is the output Sinhala Unicode?
faqItems.a: Yes. The text is standard Sinhala Unicode, so it works on Facebook, WhatsApp, Gmail, Word, Google Docs and websites without any special font.

faqItems.q: How do I convert Unicode Sinhala to FM Abhaya?
faqItems.a: Type or paste Sinhala in the editor and open the FM Abhaya tab under “Other formats”. Copy that text into Photoshop or Illustrator and set the font to FM Abhaya.

faqItems.q: Can I type Sinhala by voice?
faqItems.a: Yes. Press Speak and talk in Sinhala. Voice typing uses your browser's built-in speech recognition and works best in Chrome and Edge. For long recordings and higher accuracy, use HelaVoice transcription.

faqItems.q: Is my text saved or uploaded?
faqItems.a: Your text stays in your browser. It is saved locally so it is still there if you refresh, and it is never sent to our servers.

faqItems.q: How do I type ං, ඳ or ශ්‍රී?
faqItems.a: Type x for ං (laxkaava → ලංකාව), zdh for ඳ, zg for ඟ, and shrii for ශ්‍රී. The key guide on this page lists every letter.

textToSpeech.faqTitle: Sinhala text to speech — common questions

faqItems.q: What is a Sinhala voice generator?
faqItems.a: A Sinhala voice generator turns written Sinhala into spoken audio. Our Sinhala text to speech tool does this with AI voices: type or paste Sinhala (or type Singlish), pick one of eight voices and download the result as a WAV file.

faqItems.q: Is Sinhala text to speech free?
faqItems.a: Your first minute of audio (about 700 characters) is free with a free HelaVoice account. After that it costs 1 credit per 700 characters, using the same credits as transcription and subtitles.

faqItems.q: Can I type in English letters?
faqItems.a: Yes. Turn on Singlish typing and type words like “ayubowan” — they turn into Sinhala as you type. Then generate the audio.

faqItems.q: How long can the text be?
faqItems.a: Up to 1,400 characters per audio clip, which is roughly two minutes of speech. For longer text, generate it in parts.

faqItems.q: Can I download the audio?
faqItems.a: Yes. Every clip plays in your browser and can be downloaded as a WAV file.

faqItems.q: Which voices are available?
faqItems.a: Eight voices with different characters — firm, breezy, youthful, warm, upbeat and more. Pick one before you generate.

faqItems.q: How do I do Sinhala voice typing online?
faqItems.a: Open this page in Chrome or Edge, press Speak, allow the microphone and talk in Sinhala. Your speech is turned into Sinhala Unicode text in the editor, ready to copy.

faqItems.q: Is Sinhala voice typing free?
faqItems.a: Yes. It is free and there is no sign-up. It uses the speech recognition built into your browser.

faqItems.q: Which browsers does it work in?
faqItems.a: It works best in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge, on computers and Android phones. On iPhone, use Chrome or Safari. If you do not see the Speak button, your browser does not support speech recognition.

faqItems.q: Can I use it for WhatsApp, Facebook or Word?
faqItems.a: Yes. The text is standard Sinhala Unicode. Press Copy and paste it into WhatsApp, Facebook, Gmail, Word or Google Docs.

faqItems.q: The microphone is not working. What should I do?
faqItems.a: Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then reload the page. Voice typing is often blocked in private or incognito tabs, so use a normal tab.

faqItems.q: Does HelaVoice record my voice?
faqItems.a: No. HelaVoice does not record or store your voice. Recognition is done by your browser's speech service (in Chrome, that is a Google service), and the text stays in your browser.

faqItems.q: Can I turn a recording or a WhatsApp voice note into Sinhala text?
faqItems.a: Voice typing listens while you speak. For recordings, voice notes and videos, use HelaVoice transcription: upload the file and get the text.

faqItems.q: Can I also type Sinhala with the keyboard here?
faqItems.a: Yes. Type in English letters (Singlish) and the editor turns each word into Sinhala, so you can fix any word the microphone got wrong.

faqItems.q: How do I convert Sinhala audio to text?
faqItems.a: Log in to HelaVoice, open your dashboard, choose Upload and select your audio file. We show the length of the audio and the credits it needs, you confirm, and the Sinhala text appears for you to edit, copy or download.

faqItems.q: Can I try Sinhala audio to text for free?
faqItems.a: {freeNote} There is no subscription.

faqItems.q: Do I need to sign in to convert audio?
faqItems.a: Yes. Converting a file uses your credits, so you log in with a HelaVoice account first, and creating one is free. If you only want to dictate live, our free Sinhala voice typing page needs no account.

faqItems.q: Which audio formats can I upload?
faqItems.a: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC and WebM files. If you have a video, use our Sinhala subtitle generator, which reads the audio track of the video.

faqItems.q: How big can the audio file be?
faqItems.a: Up to {maxMb} MB per file. Longer recordings use more credits.

faqItems.q: How many credits does a recording use?
faqItems.a: 1 credit covers up to {chunkMin} minutes of audio. We split your recording into {chunkMin}-minute parts and each part uses 1 credit, so a {exampleMinutes}-minute file uses {exampleCredits} credits. We show the exact number before you confirm.

faqItems.q: How much does Sinhala audio to text cost?
faqItems.a: You pay with credits, not a subscription: packs start at {starterPrice} for {starterCredits} credits, and credits do not expire. Each credit covers up to {chunkMin} minutes of audio.

faqItems.q: Can I convert a WhatsApp voice note to Sinhala text?
faqItems.a: Yes, if the voice note is saved as a file in one of the supported formats. Save it from WhatsApp to your phone or computer and upload it like any other audio. If the uploader says the format is not supported, convert the file to MP3 or M4A first.

faqItems.q: Can it label speakers or add timestamps?
faqItems.a: Yes. After you choose a file, switch on Conversation mode to label each speaker (Speaker 1, Speaker 2, …) or Timestamps to add [mm:ss] markers, then confirm.

faqItems.q: Can I edit and download the Sinhala text?
faqItems.a: Yes. You can edit the transcript, copy it, or download it as PDF, Word (.docx), plain text (.txt) or Markdown (.md). Transcripts stay in your account until you delete them.

faqItems.q: Which language does it transcribe?
faqItems.a: Sinhala. The converter writes Sinhala speech as Sinhala text. Once a transcript is ready, a Translate button can turn it into English; that uses extra credits, shown before you confirm.

faqItems.q: What is the difference between this and Sinhala voice typing?
faqItems.a: Voice typing writes your words live while you speak into the microphone, and it is free. This converter turns an audio file you already have into text and uses credits.

faqItems.q: How accurate is the Sinhala transcript?
faqItems.a: It depends on the recording. We give no accuracy figure, because results change with audio quality, background noise, overlapping speakers and accent. A clear recording of one speaker gives the cleanest text, and you should check names, numbers and places before you use the transcript.

faqItems.q: How do I get text from a Sinhala photo?
